import json,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/results/step-001')
print((root/'build-report.json').read_text())
man=json.loads((root/'guardianai-linux-x86_64'/'manifest.json').read_text())
print('KEYS', sorted(man))
print('ARCH', man.get('architecture'))
print('POLICY', man.get('native_policy'))
print('GUARD', man.get('launch_guard_version'))
names=sorted(man.get('files_sha256',{}))
print('HASH_COUNT', len(names))
for n in names:
    print('FILE', n)
z=zipfile.ZipFile(root/'GuardianAI-linux-x86_64.zip')
members=z.namelist()
print('ZIP_COUNT', len(members))
for n in members:
    print('ZIP', n)
print('AGENT_OBSERVER_HASH', 'agent_observer.py' in names)
print('AGENT_OBSERVER_ZIP', 'agent_observer.py' in members)
